title: EStopEndpointAcceptanceSpecificationV4
description: Authoritative Gate C8 acceptance contract incorporating the empirically approved 10.0 ms persistence window, ISO 14253-1 guarded decision rules, and decoupled safety endpoints.

acceptance_criteria.acceptance_rule: delta_t_electrical_traction <= 48.8 ms WITH sustained I_motor_RMS <= 0.413 A for >= 10.0 ms AND delta_t_contactor <= 35.0 ms AND vendor component certificate (Cat 4 / PLe / SIL-3) on file.

electrical_traction_deenergized.measured_by: Keysight DSO + Tektronix TCP303 Current Clamp on Phase U

contactor_open.measured_by: DSO Channel 2 monitoring auxiliary microswitch logic level (24V -> 0V)

dc_bus_isolated.decoupling_rationale: Inverter DC link capacitors remain energized after motor current cutoff.

brake_control_deenergized.measured_by: DSO Channel 4 monitoring brake solenoid coil voltage (24V -> 0V)

mechanical_brake_applied.measured_by: IMU longitudinal deceleration trace (a >= 1.5 m/s^2) or caliper displacement sensor

vehicle_motion_stopped.measured_by: Wheel speed quadrature encoder frequency == 0 Hz
